items.title: 迪拜Palm Jumeirah两座人行天桥正式开工
items.title_en: Dubai begins two pedestrian bridges on Palm Jumeirah
items.summary: 迪拜道路与交通管理局与Dubai Holding Community Management合作，在Palm Jumeirah的Shoreline入口及Golden Mile建设两座人行天桥，分别计划于2027年6月及10月完工，合计通行能力约每小时2700人。
items.summary_en: Dubai's Roads and Transport Authority and Dubai Holding Community Management have commenced construction on two pedestrian bridges near Shoreline and Golden Mile at Palm Jumeirah. Completion is scheduled for June and October 2027, with combined capacity of about 2,700 people per hour.
items.why_it_matters: 两座天桥均已进入施工阶段，并非仍开放的总包招标。
items.why_it_matters_en: Both bridges have entered construction and are not presented as open prime-contract tenders.
items.gci_opportunity: 关注道路施工、钢结构、机电及配套材料采购。
items.gci_opportunity_en: Monitor civil works, structural steel, MEP and related material procurement.

items.title: 阿曼苏哈尔Voltamp拟投资2000万里亚尔建设电力变压器工厂
items.title_en: Oman's Voltamp plans RO20 million export-focused transformer factory in Sohar Freezone
items.category: 投资计划及土地租赁协议
items.summary: Voltamp Energy在Sohar Freezone签署土地租赁协议，计划投入2000万阿曼里亚尔分期建设出口型电力变压器工厂，总规划产能5000MVA，首期预计2027年完成。
items.summary_en: Voltamp Energy signed a land lease in Sohar Freezone for a proposed RO20 million power-transformer plant serving export markets. Planned capacity is 5,000 MVA, with phased investment and first-stage completion targeted for 2027.
items.why_it_matters: 已取得土地开发安排，但属于拟建工厂投资，不代表EPC合同已授出。
items.why_it_matters_en: A land agreement is in place, but this is a proposed industrial investment rather than an announced EPC award.
items.gci_opportunity: 跟进厂房建设、生产设备和供应链招采。
items.gci_opportunity_en: Track factory construction, manufacturing equipment and supply-chain procurement.
items.stage: 土地租约已签／规划建设

items.title: 阿曼塞拉莱自由区拟建1000万里亚尔综合石膏建材工厂
items.title_en: Oman's IGC plans integrated gypsum products facility at Salalah Free Zone with up to RO10 million first-phase investment
items.summary: Integrated Gypsum Company签署塞拉莱自由区次级土地使用权协议，计划建设石膏制品与现代建筑材料工业设施，首期目标投资最高1000万里亚尔；工程实施仍取决于后续审批和建设安排。
items.summary_en: Integrated Gypsum Company signed a sub-usufruct agreement to develop a gypsum products and modern building materials facility in Salalah Free Zone, targeting up to RO10 million in initial investment. Implementation remains subject to subsequent project arrangements.
items.why_it_matters: 首期目标投资不等于已经形成等额施工合同。
items.why_it_matters_en: The first-phase investment target should not be confused with an awarded construction contract.
items.gci_opportunity: 关注建材生产线、厂房和辅助设施采购。
items.gci_opportunity_en: Monitor production-line, industrial building and utility-system procurement.

items.title: 阿曼佐法尔Habroot签署约90.4万里亚尔21套住宅建设协议
items.title_en: Oman signs RO904,123 agreement for 21 homes in Habroot, Dhofar
items.summary: 阿曼住房与城市规划部与Rikan基金会签署Habroot Triangle住宅建设协议，涉及21套住宅，金额904123阿曼里亚尔，预计2028年底交付。
items.summary_en: Oman's Ministry of Housing and Urban Planning signed an agreement with the Rikan foundation for 21 homes at Habroot Triangle in Dhofar, valued at RO904,123 with handover expected by late 2028.
items.why_it_matters: 该项目已有明确金额和两年建设安排，规模较小。
items.why_it_matters_en: This is a defined small-scale housing project with an established value and two-year delivery programme.
items.gci_opportunity: 关注住宅施工及建筑材料供货。
items.gci_opportunity_en: Monitor housing construction and building-material supply.

items.title: 阿联酋Masdar参与马来西亚彭亨州200MW浮动光伏项目动工
items.title_en: UAE's Masdar breaks ground on 200 MW Chereh Dam floating solar project in Malaysia
items.summary: 阿联酋Masdar与Citaglobal及TIZA Global合作在马来西亚彭亨州为200MW Chereh Dam浮动光伏项目举办开工仪式，预计2028年投运，施工阶段预计创造约1500个岗位。工程地点位于马来西亚，不在阿联酋。
items.summary_en: UAE-based Masdar, Citaglobal and TIZA Global held a groundbreaking ceremony for the 200 MW Chereh Dam floating solar project in Pahang, Malaysia, targeting operation in 2028 and around 1,500 development and construction jobs. The project is located in Malaysia, not the UAE.
items.why_it_matters: 阿联酋企业参与海外新能源工程，但不意味着存在阿联酋本地建设招标。
items.why_it_matters_en: This is an overseas renewable-energy project involving a UAE company, not a UAE domestic construction tender.
items.gci_opportunity: 关注浮式支架、电气设备与工程供应商后续需求。
items.gci_opportunity_en: Monitor floating platforms, electrical equipment and engineering-supplier opportunities.

items.title: 西班牙马德里自治区Meco市政公共照明节能改造采购
items.title_en: Spain's Meco launches public-lighting energy-services and refurbishment tender valued at EUR4.94 million
items.summary: 马德里自治区Meco市政府对公共照明能源服务、设备供应与改造工程开展综合采购，采购编号1568/2026，估算合同总值约493.85万欧元，投标截止2026年11月26日。
items.summary_en: Meco municipality in the Madrid region is procuring an integrated public-lighting energy-service, supply and refurbishment contract, reference 1568/2026. Estimated contract value is approximately EUR4.94 million, with bids due 26 November 2026.
items.why_it_matters: 处于公开采购阶段，估算总价值不是已授合同金额。
items.why_it_matters_en: The procurement is open; the estimated value is not an awarded contract amount.
items.gci_opportunity: 关注节能照明、户外设备安装及长期运营服务。
items.gci_opportunity_en: Monitor efficient lighting, installation and long-term energy-service opportunities.

items.title: 葡萄牙里斯本67万欧元公共道路艺术设施LED照明设计施工招标
items.title_en: Lisbon tenders EUR670,000 design-build LED lighting for roadway public structures
items.summary: 里斯本市政府发布三标段道路公共艺术及构筑物LED照明设计施工采购，预算67万欧元，最初公告于10月20日发布，并于10月28日修订；采购目录列示投标截止2026年11月10日。
items.summary_en: The Municipality of Lisbon is tendering a three-lot design-build package for monumental LED lighting on roadway structures, with a EUR670,000 base value. The original notice was issued on 20 October and amended on 28 October; the procurement listing shows a 10 November 2026 bid deadline.
items.why_it_matters: 官方公报确认项目及总预算，截止时间应以正式投标平台最新文件为准。
items.why_it_matters_en: The Portuguese official gazette confirms the project and budget; the latest electronic tender platform controls the final deadline.
items.gci_opportunity: 关注城市照明设计、施工和供货机会。
items.gci_opportunity_en: Monitor municipal lighting design, installation and equipment supply.
items.stage: 公开招标／11月10日目录截止
items.source_name: Diário da República / Municipality of Lisbon
